subject: Request: bridge letter & evidence index to cover post-report period
messages:
From: Aisha Barnes <aisha.barnes@coastlineanalytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II bridge note request (post-report gap)

Hi Connor,

Hope youre well. Coastline Analytics has completed our procurement security review, and our legal/audit team is requesting a bridge letter (bridgenote) to cover the period after Redwoods SOC 2 Type II report end date (report period ended 2024-12-31) up to our contract effective date (2025-09-30).

Specific asks from our side:
- A signed bridge letter confirming no material control changes since 2024-12-31 or, if there are changes, a summary and compensating controls.
- An evidence index (mapping of system controls to sample artifacts) so our auditors can sample items quickly.
- A DOCUSIGN-enabled signing flow for the bridgenote (PDF preferred).
- Any interim attestations (if available) or management statements that clarify operational continuity.

Would you be able to provide a bridgenote + evidence index and an expected timeline for delivery? If you prefer, we can accept a redline-friendly Word draft first, then DocuSign for signatures.

Attachments wed expect from vendors: recent SOC 2 report (PDF), draft bridgenote, and an evidence index spreadsheet. If you already have standard templates, please share.

Thanks — we need the package for our September board review, so a turnaround in ~10 business days would be ideal.

Best,
Aisha Barnes
Head of Vendor Risk, Coastline Analytics
Attachments: (none included in this message)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Barnes <aisha.barnes@coastlineanalytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II bridge note request (post-report gap)

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear note and timeline. We can absolutely provide a bridgenote and evidence index. Quick plan:

1) Ill attach Redwoods latest SOC 2 Type II report (2024) and an initial bridgenote draft for your review.
2) Marissa (Security Compliance) will assemble the evidence index template and populate the most common artifacts; well flag any items that require your auditor to accept alternative evidence.
3) Well prepare a DocuSign envelope once the bridgenote draft is agreed.

Proposed timeline: initial drafts to you by Wed 2025-09-17, internal legal review & signoff by Mon 2025-09-22, final DocuSign by Tue 2025-09-23. If thats too tight for your board deadline, tell us and well prioritize.

A couple of clarifying questions before we start:
- Do you need the bridgenote to be signed by an exec (COO/CISO) or is a Security/Compliance director signature sufficient?
- Do you require per-control evidence (e.g., sample artifacts for every control) or a risk-based index with links to representative artifacts?

Im attaching: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf, bridgenote-draft.docx, evidence-index-template.xlsx.

Connor — thanks for taking point. Quick notes from legal/compliance triage:
- Legal prefers the bridgenote to be signed by the CISO-level exec for customer-facing attestations; Security Compliance director can sign interim communications but final bridgenote should have an exec signature if the customer requests it.
- For the evidence index: prioritize auditor-friendly artifacts (control owners, control evidence filename, access link, date). We should mark anything that is restricted and provide redacted alternatives.
- Ill loop in Legal if there are wording changes on the bridgenote draft.

If you need me to handle the DocuSign envelope routing, I can run that after Legal signs off.

—Kimberly
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Barnes <aisha.barnes@coastlineanalytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II bridge note request (post-report gap)

Connor, Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. The proposed timeline looks good for our board packet. For signatures, our auditors prefer an exec-level signatory, but they will accept an attestation from a named CISO/VP Security.

Two small asks:
- When you send the bridgenote draft, can you embed a short "Change log" section that lists any deviations from the SOC 2 period covered?
- For the evidence index, wed like a column indicating whether artifacts are available via a secure link or must be shared as redacted copies.

Once we receive the draft bridgenote and evidence index on Wednesday, well review and confirm quickly. Please send the DocuSign envelope once legal confirms exec signatory routing so we can finalize signatures before 2025-09-30.

Appreciate the help — looking forward to the drafts.

Best,
Aisha Barnes
Head of Vendor Risk, Coastline Analytics
